threads.body: Please rename this variable to be more descriptive.

instructions: Commit and push any code changes.

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids rest-thread-11 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. Rerun the same command now.
